title: Equivariant linear isometries and infinite little discs operads via transfer systems
summary: In this article, we apply the recently developed theory of transfer systems to study the relationship between $G$-equivariant linear isometries and infinite little discs operads, for a finite group $G$. This framework allows us to reduce involved topological problems to discrete problems regarding the subgroup structure and representation theory of the group $G$. Our main result is an example of this: we classify the $G$-universes $\mathcal{U}$ for which the linear isometries operad $\mathcal{L}(\mathcal{U})$ and the infinite little discs operad $\mathcal{D}(\mathcal{U})$ are homotopically…
